description: Playtest the game with its autoplay bots and compare against a saved baseline. Bots play fixed-seed scenarios in real Chrome, one at a time, against the running game; Glitchless then compares frame time (overall and per level), render CPU, draw calls, errors, crashes, completion and deaths with the baseline. Regressions fail; warnings and improvements are listed. Call with save_as "baseline" BEFORE changing code, then without arguments AFTER the change. Takes 1–5 minutes (quick: about 1). Needs the game and the Glitchless server running and Playwright installed in the project.

compare_to.description: Saved run to compare with (default "baseline" when saved)

game.description: The game, by name or id, when signed in to a workspace (glitchless_list_games lists them); later calls keep it. Ignored with a key for one game.

game_url.description: Game URL to play (default http://localhost:5173/ or glitchless.playtest.json)

max_seconds.description: Cap each run at this many seconds

quick.description: Play only the first scenario (about a minute)

save_as.description: Save this run under a name, e.g. "baseline" before a change

name: glitchless_playtest
title: Playtest
